landing.intro: Scan your medicine. Hear how to take it, in your own language. Get a reminder when it is time.
landing.forHospitals: Made for Nigerian hospitals, their staff and their patients.
landing.step1: Your hospital registers and adds its staff and patients.
landing.step2: You sign in with your hospital number and phone.
landing.step3: Scan your medicine pack. We read the label to you and set your reminders.
landing.safety: Medisent AI helps you follow your prescription. It does not replace your doctor or pharmacist.
